reasoning: thinking_level xhigh (Antigravity offers low, medium, high, xhigh for Neon; xhigh is the level the Cursor runs used)
runner: Antigravity ACP server 1.4.5 (agy_acp_server.par with localharness_external, release 923923a0d7dc8073f66cc6f78647a3107e3a7ee2b7e1a24df8b3927b5188013b, the build T3 Code installs) driven headless by runner/acp-run.mjs over the Agent Client Protocol, on t3os (Ubuntu 26.04, Ryzen 7 5700U)
replaces: The Cursor CLI runs of 2026-11-19 (records in cursor/), which Dara suspected the Cursor harness had made worse. Same model, reasoning level, prompts (ports aside), starter, skill file and browser; only the harness differs.
client: runner/acp-run.mjs: initialize (no client file system or terminal, so the agent uses its own tools), session/new with the workspace as cwd and the browser MCP server, session/set_mode yolo (full access), session/set_config_option model=gemini-4-neon then thinking_level=xhigh, one session/prompt with the prompt file, every permission request approved, every JSON-RPC message logged with a timestamp.
wrapper: sudo unshare --mount; mount --bind empty-etc /etc/codex and /etc/claude-code; mount --bind <run>/tmp /tmp; setpriv --reuid=dara --regid=dara --init-groups; env -i
isolation: Fresh HOME per session; its GEMINI_HOME held only a copy of the Antigravity sign-in (acp_token.json, Google OAuth) and settings {auth: oauth-personal}. The box's agent instruction folders (/etc/codex, /etc/claude-code) and the shared /tmp were hidden. Antigravity loads no MCP servers, plugins or user rules from that home. Context isolation, not a filesystem jail.
harnessFiles: Antigravity writes skills/system/run-workflow/SKILL.md (its built-in run-workflow skill) into every workspace it opens. It is listed in the source hashes and left out of the gallery copy.
browser: Playwright MCP 0.0.83 passed as an ACP session MCP server named browser: --browser chromium --isolated --headless --viewport-size 1440x960 --image-responses allow, Chromium 1247, the same setup as the Cursor, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol runs. Antigravity's ACP server has no browser of its own (see preflight-native below); its tools reach MCP tools through call_mcp_tool.
starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8 starter @eeeb008, the same tarball as the Cursor Neon, Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol runs
skillLocation: work/.agents/skills/<name> (a project skill folder Antigravity reads)
promptPolicy: The gallery prompt with only the port changed (3491, 3492; the Cursor runs used 3451, 3452). One prompt, no follow-up, no orchestrator edits to the generated apps.

sessions.ending: The turn ended on its own (stopReason end_turn) with a final reply; the client then stopped the server.
The turn ended on its own (stopReason end_turn) with a final reply; the client then stopped the server.

preflight.workspace: A separate copy of the frontend-design setup with the browser MCP server.
preflight.result: Skills: the workspace's frontend-design and Antigravity's built-in run-workflow. MCP: browser, with the 25 Playwright tools loaded on demand. Built-in tools: ask_question, call_mcp_tool, define_subagent, generate_image, invoke_subagent, list_resources, manage_subagents, manage_task, read_resource, read_url_content, replace_file_content, run_command, run_workflow, schedule, search_web, send_message, view_file, write_to_file; subagents research and self. No personal, user-level or box instructions; only Antigravity's own system prompt ('You are Antigravity, a powerful agentic AI assistant designed by the Google DeepMind team.'). Described the canvas test page (gold circle, cyan square, 'HERON 63') from screenshot pixels.

preflightNative.result: The same check without the browser MCP server: no browser tool, browser subagent or MCP server, so it couldn't take the screenshot. That is why the scored sessions got the same Playwright MCP server as the Cursor runs.

timing: The two scored sessions ran at the same time on one machine, alongside a Motion session; this is not a latency benchmark.
cost: costs.json: API-equivalent estimates from each session's reported usage at Google's Gemini 4 Neon paid-tier rates. Antigravity ran on Dara's Antigravity subscription, so these are estimates, not charges.
generationPolicy: Original sources hashed before gallery adaptation (<condition>.source-sha256.json). Generation happened outside the gallery checkout, in ~/Code/bench-neon-agy on t3os. The original projects aren't uploaded anywhere.
